name: Result list
summary: Up to eight results as cards: a photo, the name, one meta line, an optional detail and badge, a price and one button each.
use: when someone asks to find or be shown a few places, stays, products or services and will open one
a11y: A list of results, each with its name as text and its photo described; each button is named with its result ("View, Casa da Calçada").

use_when: a short list of results to scan and open one: stays, restaurants, products, classes or venues
avoid_when: two to four options compared on the same attributes: use comparison
one item in detail: use product-card
rows of records with many columns: use data-table

parts.name: note
parts.what: how many results, and the filters that apply

parts.name: image
parts.what: a square photo of the result

parts.name: badge
parts.what: one short fact worth a badge, such as 'Free cancellation'

parts.name: value_note
parts.what: what the value covers, such as 'a night'

empty.how: no results: the list shows one dashed line saying there is nothing to show; better still, answer in text with what to change

loading.how: keep two cards with a sunken photo square and muted lines for the text

error.how: a photo that fails to load keeps its square, with the photo's description written in it

disabled.how: a result that cannot be opened (sold out) has its button disabled and dimmed

overflow.how: on a phone the photo stays beside the text and the price and button move to one line underneath

long_text.how: names, meta and detail wrap; the badge keeps one line with an ellipsis; the price never wraps

keyboard: Tab moves through the result buttons in list order
